newsitem.title: ITALY: Mediaset bounces after TV decree approved.
newsitem.headline: Mediaset bounces after TV decree approved.

text.p: Shares in Italian media group Mediaset bounced back after the Italian cabinet approved a television decree extending the current legal framework for television stations until January 31 1997.
The shares had opened this morning at 7,200 lire before slipping to 7,130 lire and then bounced up to 7,165 lire, up 0.53 percent, just after the government's announcement.

The move plugs a legal void in which magistrates could have forced Mediaset to take one of its three TV stations off the air. But the share reaction was largely muted because the extension was largely expected by share dealers.
